title.zh: KelpDAO sues LayerZero for the largest exploit 2026 has seen so far
title.en: KelpDAO sues LayerZero for the largest exploit 2026 has seen so far

current_state.zh: KelpDAO sued LayerZero and co-founder Bryan Pellegrino, alleging undisclosed cross-chain protocol weaknesses enabled the $292 million April rsETH exploit that drained 116,500 rsETH and helped trigger a broader DeFi liquidity crisis.
